headline: ITD trading 9.1σ above 20D average sets the loudest overnight signal; PF late-filing and AKS delisting timeline are the day's key compliance items.
market_take: Coverage breadth is unusually heavy on the CONS sector, with multiple intraday moves (PLE -16.67%, NL -7.25%, TPOLY +10.00%) and EMC's extreme +100.00% intraday reversal off a -50.00% open gap. PROP activity is dominated by smaller caps (JCK, PRECHA, RML, CGD) while A and JCK show divergent 5-day trajectories. PF's late Q2/2026 financial statement submission and AKS's confirmed delisting window (Oct 12-22) are the filings most likely to drive RM dialogue today.
